```{r setup}
library(toupac)
```


`toupac` provides convenience functions for some common tasks. To install this package from GitHub, use

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# install.packages("remotes")
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("voob/toypackage")
```

Load the package using the following code.
The package contains three functions

* `strsplit1`

* `min_max_scale`
* `theme_academic`
